accueil.attente: The app for the day is being written. You will receive the link together with the invitation.
accueil.a_faire_rien: All that is left is to come.
accueil.film_attente: The film will be added here. It needs a connection: it is not kept offline.
accueil.periode_jour: The day is under way. This screen arrives with the wedding-day version.
accueil.periode_apres: Thank you. This screen arrives with the after version.

design.intro: Internal validation page. It is not intended for guests.
design.note_couleurs: The five colours never carry text. This is an art-direction decision: the measurements below show it does not follow from contrast alone.
design.mouvement_note: Fades and slides of 12 px at most, a single easing curve, 300 to 900 ms.

lancement.ecran3_texte: The schedule, how to get there, your reply. Nothing to install, no account to create.

retrouver.intro: The six-character code is printed under the QR code on your invitation.
retrouver.echec: We cannot find this invitation. Please check the code, or call us.
retrouver.trop_essais: Too many attempts. Please try again in an hour, or call us.

partager.intro: This link opens your invitation on another phone. It is also how you ask someone close to reply for you.
partager.non_reconnu: Please open your invitation from the QR code on your invitation card first.

erreurs.invitation_inconnue: This invitation is no longer valid.
erreurs.base_indisponible: The information will be here shortly. Please try again in a moment.

programme.intro: Five moments, from morning to night.
programme.detail_absent: The detail will be written here before the invitations are sent.
programme.agenda_journee: Until the times are set, the file adds the whole day of 3 June 2028.

infos.attente: This information will be written here before the invitations are sent.

faq.aucun_resultat: No question matches. Try another word, or call us.
faq.reponse_attendue: The answer will be written here before the invitations are sent.

reponse.question: Will you be with us?
reponse.enregistre_peutetre: Noted. We will remind you once, gently.
reponse.enregistre_non: We will miss you. We will be thinking of you.
reponse.non_suite: If you would like to leave a word for the couple, it is below. Nothing is required.
reponse.verrouille: The deadline has passed: your reply can no longer be changed here. Write to us and we will do it.
reponse.detail_titre: Who is coming, and to which moments
reponse.menu_attente: Menu choices will be added here before the deadline.
reponse.allergies_consentement: I agree that these allergies may be stored and passed to the caterer.
reponse.allergies_explication: An allergy is health data. Without your agreement we do not store it. It is visible only to the couple and the caterer, and is deleted 30 days after the wedding.
reponse.non_reconnu: Open your invitation from the QR code on your invitation card to reply.
reponse.erreur: We could not save. Please try again in a moment.
reponse.facultatif_ouvrir: Add a word, a song, where you stay

admin.refus: This area requires a valid access link.
admin.refus_detail: Access links are single-use and valid for 30 minutes. Generate a new one from the server.
admin.aucun_foyer: No household yet. Import a file to start.
admin.import_format: A semicolon-separated CSV file: foyer;invites;langue. Names within a household are separated by a vertical bar.
admin.import_bouton: Import and download the QR sheet
admin.import_avertissement: Importing generates the QR codes and backup codes, and downloads the printable sheet straight away. These codes are not stored in clear: keep the PDF.
admin.planche_avertissement: Regenerating replaces every QR code and backup code. Sheets already printed stop working. Only do this before the invitations are sent.
admin.domaine_absent: The domain is not bought yet: the sheet will use the server address.

horsligne.texte: Everything you do will be sent as soon as it is back.
horsligne.disponible: These pages stay available, as you last opened them:
horsligne.envoye: Your reply has just been sent.

texte.sens_endroit: The text, from the beginning to the end.
texte.sens_inverse: The text, from the end to the beginning.

loin.intro: You will not be able to join us. You can leave a word: we will read it.
loin.champ: Your word for Julien and Lauriane
loin.visibilite_livre: The guest book, visible to guests
loin.erreur: We could not send it. Please try again in a moment.
loin.diffusion_attente: The streaming link will be added here before the day, visible only from your invitation.

promesse.echo: Their finest promise is yet to be made.
promesse.intro: Write a wish for Julien and Lauriane. It will be sealed, and nobody will read it — not even them — before 3 June 2029.
promesse.erreur: We could not seal your wish. Please try again in a moment.
promesse.garantie: The wish is encrypted on your phone before it is sent. The server only receives a sealed envelope, and has no way to open it. It is anonymous.

annonces.intro: What Julien and Lauriane have to tell you, most recent first.
annonces.aucune: Nothing to report yet. Which is rather a good sign.

notifications.explication: Nothing is required. You may decline, or change your mind later in your phone settings.
notifications.active: You will get announcements on this phone.
notifications.refuse: Notifications are blocked for this site. You can allow them in your phone settings.
notifications.impossible: This phone does not support notifications. Nothing will be lost: everything stays in the app.

admin_annonces.notifier: Also send a notification to subscribed guests
admin_annonces.erreur: We could not publish. Please try again.
admin_annonces.push_absent: Notifications are not configured: see pnpm push:cles.

rappels.explication: We will only send what matters. You can stop at any time, with one tap.
rappels.arretes: You will no longer get reminders.
rappels.desinscrit_texte: You will no longer get reminders. Nothing else changes: your invitation is still valid.

admin_contenus.intro: Everything marked “[TO BE COMPLETED]” is filled in here. Each block saves on its own.
admin_contenus.erreur: We could not save. Please check the fields.
admin_contenus.date_mariage_fixe: Fixed: it is the reference for periods, reminders and data purges.
admin_contenus.date_limite_aide: Leave empty until it is decided. The home screen will then show no deadline.
admin_contenus.heure_aide: Local time at the venue, 24-hour format. An end earlier than the start counts as the next day.
admin_contenus.decalage: Delay set by the crew: {minutes} min
admin_contenus.nom_fixe: The name and kind of each moment are set by the art direction.
admin_contenus.lien_aide: Full address starting with https://, or nothing.
admin_contenus.lien_refuse: This link is not an http or https address.
admin_contenus.nom_contact: What to call them, in French
admin_contenus.nom_contact_en: What to call them, in English
admin_contenus.ceremonie_aide: During L’Horizon, the app invites guests to put their phone away and pauses memory sharing. Sharing resumes by itself at the end.

maintenant.sans_fin: until the end of the night
maintenant.horaires_inconnus: The times are not set yet. The programme will show them as soon as they are.
maintenant.debranchee_texte: Our photographer is taking care of the images. Sharing memories will resume by itself at the end of the ceremony.
maintenant.envois_coupes: Sharing memories is paused for now.

semaine.intro: Nothing urgent. Just enough to arrive calm.
semaine.table: I have looked up my table
semaine.ecran_accueil: I have added the app to my home screen
semaine.batterie: I have a power bank for photos
semaine.locale: This list never leaves your phone.
semaine.meteo_absente: The forecast will appear here as the day approaches.

aide.intro: Four things, and someone on the line.
aide.sans_numero: The number will be added before the day.
aide.perdu_texte: The venue, and directions from where you are.

regie.modele_ceremonie: The ceremony is about to start.
regie.decaler: Shift this moment and the ones after it
regie.etat_ceremonie: Paused automatically: the ceremony is under way.
regie.erreur: We could not save. Please try again.
regie.libre_note: A free-text announcement is sent as written in both languages. The templates above are already translated.

photos.intro: Guests’ photos and videos, as the day unfolds.
photos.aucune: Nothing yet. The first memories will arrive soon.
photos.retrait_texte: This photo will be hidden straight away, before we even look at it. You can say why, but you do not have to.
photos.retire: It is hidden. Thank you for telling us.
photos.erreur: We could not save that. Please try again.
photos.sans_foyer: Open your invitation from the QR code on your card to share.

envoi.refuses: One file could not be sent. Try again from your phone’s gallery.
envoi.suspendu: Sharing memories is paused for now. It will resume by itself, and nothing will be lost.
envoi.iphone: On iPhone, waiting uploads resume when you reopen the app, not in the background.
envoi.video_trop_longue: Videos are limited to 60 seconds. This one is longer.
envoi.type_refuse: This file type is not accepted.
envoi.metadonnees: We cannot strip the location data from this file, so we do not keep it. A JPEG, PNG or MP4 works.
envoi.consentement_texte: Your memories will be visible to other guests, inside the app only. We strip location data from files. Anyone can ask for a photo they appear in to be removed, in one tap.
envoi.consentement_enfants: If your photos show children, you can share them with the couple only.
envoi.retire: Your consent is withdrawn. Earlier uploads stay online; to remove one, use “Request removal”.
envoi.accord_actuel: Your memories are visible to guests.
envoi.accord_actuel_maries: Your memories are visible to the couple only.

table.intro: Where you are seated, and with whom.
table.sans_foyer: Open your invitation from the QR code on your card to see your table.
table.sans_plan: The seating plan will be published before the day.
table.sans_place: Your seat is not set yet. It will appear here.
table.aucun_resultat: Nobody by that name in the seating plan.
table.papier: The plan is also printed on the table cards, in case there is no network.

admin_table.intro: Create the tables, then seat each person. Nothing is visible to guests until a table is set.
admin_table.label: Table name
admin_table.erreur: We could not save. Please check the fields.

imprimables.sans_contact: No number written. To be filled in from the admin before the day.
imprimables.proc_reseau_texte: The table cards carry the programme and a phone number. The programme, practical information, FAQ and help stay readable on phones that already opened them. Photos are sent by themselves once the network is back.
imprimables.proc_app_texte: The fallback page takes over at the same address: programme, access and contacts. Nothing to do from the phone.
imprimables.proc_retard_texte: Shifting a moment from the crew screen also shifts every later one. One button restores the planned schedule.
imprimables.proc_photo_texte: Hide it from the crew screen, in one tap. The file is not deleted: the decision can be undone.

merci.intro: You were there. That is what makes this day what it is.
merci.attente: Julien and Lauriane will write a few words here after the wedding.
merci.photographe_attente: The photographer’s pictures will arrive here.
merci.film_attente: The film will be added here if there is one.
merci.archive_aide: A ZIP file, which opens on a computer as well as on a phone.
merci.fin_medias: Photos and videos will be deleted on {date}.
merci.fin_reponses: Replies and first names will be deleted on {date}.
merci.fin_allergies: Declared allergies will be deleted on {date}.

messages.intro: Words from those who could not be there, and chose to share them.

photographe.intro: The photographer’s pictures, in a section of their own.
photographe.attente: They will be added here after the wedding.
photographe.reserve: These pictures are only visible from an invitation.

film.attente: The film will be added here if there is one.

donnees.intro: What we hold for your household, and until when.
donnees.demander: To correct or delete anything, call us or write to us: we will do it.
donnees.sans_foyer: Open your invitation from the QR code on your card to see your data.

admin_photographe.intro: Add the photographer’s pictures here. They appear in a section of their own, after the wedding.

indicateurs.intro: What the brief asks us to follow, measured without any tracker. Whatever cannot be measured that way is stated as such, never approximated.
indicateurs.questions: Questions received by phone or message
indicateurs.interventions: Times Julien and Lauriane had to step in on the day
indicateurs.sans_traceur: Knowing this would mean reporting failures back from phones, which means tracking. The brief forbids it.
indicateurs.hors_application: None of this goes through the app. Note it by hand if you wish.
indicateurs.delai_titre: Median delay between opening and replying

defis.intro: One challenge per moment, if you feel like it. Nothing to win, nothing counted.

admin_defis.intro: One challenge per moment. Until a title is written, the challenge appears nowhere — even published.
admin_defis.aucun_classement: No ranking, no counter: it is an invitation to look differently, not a competition.
